sources.name: TSA checkpoint travel numbers
sources.description: Daily US airport security checkpoint throughput, used as a rough measure of how many people travel in a given week. Built from the 2025 counts; each day is averaged with the same weekday a week before and after.
sources.coverage: United States only. Other countries use a simple seasonal estimate, not derived from travel data, labeled as an estimate.
sources.accessPattern: A static index built once and shipped with the app (see scripts/build-demand-index.ts). It is not fetched live.
